Monica / Dev — forwarding the customer confirmation. Need an internal approval for two exceptions so we can respond with a concrete SOW and SLA: 

Exception requests:
A) Pilot pricing: customer requests a capped pilot price ~30% below standard list for a 6-month timeboxed pilot to get executive sign-off. They will commit to a PO if we provide that concession. Deal: HLTH-2025-042.
B) SLA credits: customer expects credits for availability at 99.9% target. Standard enterprise SLA is 99.95% with limited credits; they want language that preserves their procurement sign-off and allows our engineering fallback policy (we cannot promise hardware-level uptime beyond platform-level metrics without legal sign-off).

Why approve? Moving fast to procurement unlocks a larger expansion opportunity (Katie indicated likely expansion if pilot meets latency/cost targets). Risk: precedents for discount + SLA deviations. 

Requested approvals / actions:
- Monica: commercial OK/conditions for pilot discount and outline of negotiation boundary (max discount and approval matrix).
- Dev: can you confirm whether the runtime can meet the 99.9% availability target under a pilot (single-region) and whether we need an ops runbook or dedicated capacity to hit the SLO?
- Priyom: please review SLA language and advise on minimum legal guardrails for availability credits and fallback clauses. If a legal exception is needed, what documentation do you require?

Attaching: initial SOW stub (Healthlytics-SOW-draft.pdf) and our SOC2 (SOC2-report-2025.pdf).

Neha

Neha / team — reviewed the request. Legal position and conditional approvals: 

1) Pilot pricing exception: Commercial OK as long as we document pilot-specific pricing and include a clause that the pilot rate expires at the pilot end unless a new SOW is executed. Add a line that customer acknowledges potential price change on conversion. No additional legal docs required for discount alone.

2) SLA & credits: We can accept 99.9% target for the pilot, with capped credits (not to exceed 10% of monthly fees) and explicit exclusions for degradation due to customer-managed networks or third-party outages. Insert a fallback clause that allows Redwood to route to a lower-cost model variant or region for degraded performance with prior notice where feasible. 

3) Required evidence and gating items before contract signature:
   - SOC 2 Type II report (we have provided SOC2-report-2025.pdf; verify scope covers hosting environment).
   - Simple architecture diagram showing network egress points and data residency controls.
   - Contact info for procurement lead (we need Maria Delgado on the signature block).

4) Action: Neha — please update the SOW stub to: label as "Pilot SOW (timeboxed)"; include the pricing table with capped pilot discount; add the SLA appendix with capped credits and exclusions described above. Once you return the updated SOW, legal will prepare a short approval memo to attach to the deal record.

I will not sign a permanent SLA exception here; this is a pilot-only concession.
